title: Tamalada
description: A vibrant and detailed painting showing an extended Mexican American family working together in a bustling kitchen to prepare tamales.

title: Cumpleaños de Lala y Tudi
description: A lively print depicting the joyful chaos of a joint family birthday party happening in a family's backyard.

title: Las Pachucas, Razor Blade 'do
description: An intimate painting of three young Chicana women in a bedroom, helping each other style an elaborate 'razor blade' hairdo before a night out.

title: Heaven and Hell II
description: A split-composition painting contrasting a joyful community dance in a sunlit heaven with a dark underworld of grueling, fiery labor.

title: Camas para Sueños
description: A serene nighttime scene showing a mother preparing a bed inside a lit room, while her two young daughters rest and stargaze on the home's roof.

title: Lessons
description: A tender print capturing a family of six gathered around the dining table, deeply engaged in drawing and painting together.

title: Burning of the Codices
description: A powerful historical painting depicting the tragic destruction of indigenous Mesoamerican books by Spanish colonizers.

title: Curandera
description: A respectful depiction of a traditional Mexican American folk healer performing a spiritual and physical cleansing on a sick woman in her bedroom.

title: Lotería-Primera Tabla
description: An intricate print modeled after a traditional Mexican bingo board, filled with the artist's personal and cultural symbols.

title: Don Pedrito Jaramillo, Falfurrias, Texas 1829-1907
description: A triptych print honoring the legendary South Texas folk healer Don Pedrito Jaramillo, presented in the style of a religious altarpiece.

title: Abuelitos Pizcando Nopalitos
description: A serene early morning scene of an older couple carefully harvesting young prickly pear cactus pads in the South Texas landscape.

title: Nopalitos para ti
description: An intimate depiction of the careful, labor-intensive process of cleaning spines from prickly pear cactus pads in a domestic kitchen.

title: Raspas con Nieve
description: A detailed print capturing the nostalgic community experience of gathering around a shaved ice stand on a hot Texas summer day.
